name: @olai/plugin-build
//exports: TWO DOORS, TWO GRAPHS — the same discipline every other package in this tree keeps. The ROOT is the compiler, and it carries babel; `./shared` is the three module names and the global the host binds them through, and it carries nothing at all. A TAB opens the second: `@olai/web`'s entry fills that table out of its own static imports, so a chunk the serve compiled reaches this app's Solid rather than a second copy. Behind one door the browser bundle would carry the Solid JSX transform to read four string constants.
//:
HOW A PLUGIN'S SOURCE BECOMES A MODULE — the one package that turns text somebody wrote into a half olai can mount, and the whole of what phase 12 (dynamic plugins) needs that no existing package could honestly hold.

It knows nothing about vaults, rows, approval or the wire: it takes source and answers a module's TEXT, or a refusal naming the specifier it will not resolve. That fence is what makes it testable without a serve, and it is why the vault half lives in @olai/server and the mounting in the bridge.
//dependencies:
The Solid JSX transform, and NOTHING else. `@babel/core` plus the two presets are exactly what `@olai/web`'s own build uses on the app's faces (packages/web/src/build.ts argues why Bun's transform cannot stand in: it emits `React.createElement`, which Solid does not have, and Bun's `jsxImportSource` is not honoured by `Bun.Transpiler` or `Bun.build` in the pinned version). An agent-written face has to compile the same way a shipped one does, or `@olai/plugin-api`'s slots would hold two kinds of component.

The SERVER half needs no preset: it is TypeScript with no JSX in it, and `Bun.Transpiler` is the whole of that step.

Deliberately absent: `effect`, `@olai/plugin-api`, `solid-js`. This package NAMES them as the specifiers it will bind and imports none of them — they are the running binary's, reached through the registry a host puts on `globalThis` (./src/shared.ts), which is the only way a dynamically loaded chunk can share one Solid and one Effect with the app it draws inside.
